request.purpose: We plan a direct-mail advertising campaign for food supplements and want to target the districts with the most patients.
request.question: Among patients with atrial fibrillation aged 65 and over, how many have no active oral anticoagulant, by age band?
definitions: Atrial fibrillation = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I48.
Oral anticoagulant = ATC code starting with B01AA or B01AF.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per band: patients with atrial fibrillation, how many of them have no active oral anticoagulant and that share in %, one decimal.
